'''Ocsin''' was a stormy and gloomy [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Ocsin system/Legends|Ocsin system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. It was situated at the intersection of the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] known as the [[Authority Guardian Corridor]] and the [[Tertiary Etti Route]], which connected it to the [[Fether system/Legends|Fether]] and [[Kamar system/Legends|Kamar systems]] and the [[Farana system/Legends|Farana]] and [[Gaurick system/Legends|Gaurick systems]], respectively. Ocsin was a [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Ocsin]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TEA" />

A few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Ocsin&mdash;by then a part of the [[Farana (region)/Legends|Farana]] region&mdash;accepted annexation by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. The Ocsin were to provide the Authority with [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] navigational data that their [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] had compiled; however, while afterward CSA [[Information broker/Legends|infochants]] frequently visited the world in order to obtain information on trade routes, the Authority never provided Ocsin with the technological help that it had promised in return.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ocsin was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-3.<ref name="TEA" />
